The issuer exhibits exceptionally strong credit fundamentals, characterized by massive scale (revenue of $82.9B in Q3 alone), elite profitability margins (operating margin of 46%, net income of $31.8B), and a highly robust balance sheet with $414.4B in shareholders' equity against $279.9B in total liabilities. While the current ratio of 1.28 is adequate rather than highly liquid, the sheer volume of retained earnings ($302.5B) and immense cash-generating capacity represent an extremely low default risk profile consistent with the highest credit quality.

DECISION: AAA
